text: I told my suitcase we're skipping our holiday this year. Now it's carrying emotional baggage.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My boss says I have a real talent for delegation. I've already assigned someone else to accept the award.
author: GLM 5.3

text: The self-checkout accused me of an unexpected item in the bagging area. Honestly, I didn't see the accusation coming either.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My sourdough starter is exhausting. It needs feeding every morning — the neediest culture I've ever kept.
author: GLM 5.3

text: I asked the chef how he stays so calm. He said he just takes everything with a pinch of salt.
author: GLM 5.3

text: I keep losing one sock per wash. At this point I think the machine is collecting sole mates.
author: GLM 5.3

text: I had a huge argument with my iron. It really knows how to press my buttons.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My origami hobby didn't survive its first month. It folded under pressure.
author: GLM 5.3

text: I applied to the chess club. They said they'd check my form and then call me mate.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My Roomba keeps filing complaints about my floors. I think it's tired of sweeping problems under the rug.
author: GLM 5.3

text: I broke up with my microwave. Every argument got heated and was over in thirty seconds.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My banana finally booked that therapy session. Now it's peeling much better.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My thermostat is giving me the silent treatment, which is very on brand for someone so hot and cold.
author: GLM 5.3

text: I asked my herbalist friend for life advice. She just raised an eyebrow and offered me some sage wisdom.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My partner says I have selective hearing, so I've chosen not to hear about it.
author: GLM 5.3

text: I finally switched off autocorrect. Now all my mistakes arrive with total confidence.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My wallet has been on a diet. It's already lost all its bills.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My yoga instructor says I've made incredible progress. Honestly, that feels like a bit of a stretch.
author: GLM 5.3

text: I finally dipped into my emergency fund. There was a shoe emergency.
author: GLM 5.3

text: My salad showed up to dinner overdressed. The vinaigrette was doing far too much.
author: GLM 5.3
